Moderate a single non-flagged input

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ModerationRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ModerationRequest::from_json(json_encode(["input" => "The weather is nice today.", "model" => "omni-moderation-latest"]));
$result = LiterLlm::moderate($req);
var_dump($result->getResults());
var_dump($result->getResults()[0]->flagged);
```
